GenMeta UI · buttons & controls

UI hygiene audit

Checked: genmeta-platform.vercel.app/app at main f5b3a6a, 27 Sep 2026, at 1440 and 1280px. 43 routes: every page, all 5 asset tabs, 10 lineage and 5 DQ sub-tabs, both Knowledge graph views, and all 17 Admin pages, plus the 5 Data sources tabs inside the iframe. Computed styles were measured in Chromium and cross-checked against src/*.css and the JSX. No code was changed.

Top 5 problems

  1. No shared button components. Every page writes its own buttons, so sizes have drifted: 15 control heights (20–48px), 7 corner radii and 7 font sizes. The same row often mixes 34px and 36px buttons.
  2. The same control looks different on different pages. There are 3 styles of segmented toggle, 5 tab styles (and sub-tabs look exactly like main tabs), 8 chip styles, 4 badge systems, and dropdowns that are half native browser selects and half custom.
  3. Hover, focus and disabled states are weak or missing. The secondary button hover is practically invisible (#FFF → #FBFDFF). The keyboard focus ring is a thin 1.5px line. A disabled Save button still darkens on hover. Tabs, toggles, dropdowns and the back button have no hover at all.
  4. Data sources is a separate mini-app. It runs in an iframe with its own CSS: a slightly different navy (#0D264F) and blue (#447DE6), 14.5px text, 29px "xs" buttons, and page padding that is 8px off. It feels like another product.
  5. Layout rough edges. Buttons don't line up with the inputs next to them. There are five navy Approve buttons in one list. The floating Ask button covers content on every page. There is no pagination anywhere (the catalogue shows all 50, the marketplace shows all 106).

Issue list

#1Header action row

Page
Data catalogue › asset (all tabs)
What's wrong
Star and Back icon buttons are 34px, Copy name and Ask are 36px. That puts two heights in one row, and the icon buttons are visibly shorter.
Benchmark
Primer and Geist: an icon-only button is a square at the same height as the text buttons beside it (32×32 next to 32).
Fix
Every header action is lg 36. Icon-only buttons use .btn.secondary.icon at 36×36.

#2Start from / Depth / Expand form

Page
Knowledge graph › Graph explorer
What's wrong
The input is 38px, the select is 33px (native OS chevron) and Expand is 36px. The Expand button sits 24px lower than the input, and the two labels sit on different lines.
Benchmark
Supabase and Geist: inputs, selects and buttons share one size scale; form rows align to the bottom edge.
Fix
Use align-items:flex-end and put every control in the row at lg 36. Use the custom .select. Remove the extra top offset on the Depth label.

#3Card header and filters

Page
Knowledge graph › Galaxy
What's wrong
The Graph/List toggle floats above the card title instead of sitting on the same line. "All sources" is a native select. Source chips are 36px tall with an 8px radius, taller than the search box beside them.
Benchmark
Linear and Vercel put the view switch on the right of the title row. Atlan's filter chips are compact (about 28px).
Fix
Put the title and toggle in one flex row. Toolbar controls are md 32. Source chips use the standard .chip at 28px with a 6px radius.

#4Segmented toggles

Page
Data estate, Data quality, Admin › Users, Data sources
What's wrong
Four looks for one control:
  • .toggle: navy fill when on (2D/3D)
  • .seg2: tint with royal text (Metadata/Live)
  • .seg: underlined lowercase words ("all active invited suspended")
  • the Data sources list/grid switch
Benchmark
Primer SegmentedControl is one component: a 32px track with an inset selected pill.
Fix
Keep only the .seg2 look at md 32. The selected segment is --ice with --navy text; navy fill stays reserved for primary buttons. Use sentence case, and add counts on status filters. Counts in the image are illustrative.

#5Tabs and sub-tabs

Page
Asset › Lineage / Data quality; Graph explorer; Code analyzer; Admin
What's wrong
Sub-tabs (Graph, End to end…) use exactly the same underline style as the main asset tabs, so there's no hierarchy. There are also 5 tab bases:
  • .tabs 46px / 13.5px
  • .asset-tabs 43px / 14px
  • .ls-tabs 38px / 13px
  • the iframe tabs, 43px / 14.5px
Benchmark
Atlassian and Atlan use underline tabs for page level and lighter pill-style navigation inside a section. Primer UnderlineNav is a 48px bar with 2px active line.
Fix
Level 1: one .tabs style, 44px, 14px/500, 2px --royal underline. Level 2: new .subtabs, 28px pills whose active state is --ice.

#6Button states

Page
Site-wide
What's wrong
The "now" images, from top to bottom:
  • The secondary button at rest and on hover, which look almost the same.
  • The focus ring: 1.5px, 3px offset, with a 4px radius that doesn't match the 8px button.
  • The disabled Save changes button (opacity .7) and the same button on hover, which still darkens.
  • The disabled Ask send button, which uses a different grey.
There are also 6 local 2px focus rules, 4 different ring RGB values, and 6 different disabled treatments.
Benchmark
Primer: a 2px accent focus ring; disabled uses muted tokens, not opacity. Geist: a 2px gap and then a 2px blue ring. Every system gives the secondary button a visible hover.
Fix
One --ring token used by every :focus-visible. Hover changes are visible (secondary gets --mist and a --muted border). Disabled means --ice background, --faint text, and no hover.

#7Inputs, selects, sizes

Page
Lineage filter bar, Catalogue sort, Admin › SSO, Data sources
What's wrong
The 22 <select>s are styled 6 ways:
  • Some use the native OS chevron (sort, SSO, Galaxy, Explorer, Data sources).
  • Others use a custom chevron (lineage bar, catalogue rail).
Heights also vary:
  • Inputs: 32, 34, 36 and 38px.
  • Buttons: 29, 30, 34 and 36px.
Benchmark
Supabase maps inputs and buttons to one size table. The consensus scale is 28/32/40.
Fix
Three sizes (sm 28 / md 32 / lg 36) shared by button, input, select, segmented and chip. .select uses appearance:none plus one chevron.

#8Duplicate and conflicting styles

Page
Site-wide (CSS)
What's wrong
In the code:
  • pro.css overrides nearly every control in styles.css, so about 40% of those rules are dead.
  • These classes are defined twice: .icon-btn (styles.css:303 and :523) and .status (pro.css:114 and :414).
  • 8px is hard-coded in 7 places instead of var(--r-ctl).
  • There are near-duplicate classes (.kg-clear, .rail-clear, .fmore, .rel-link) and unused ones (.btn.link, VendorChip).
  • There are 150 raw <button>s and no Button component.
Benchmark
Primer, Atlassian and Supabase all ship one Button component with size and variant props.
Fix
Add Button, IconButton, Segmented, Tabs and Badge to ui.jsx. Delete the dead control rules in styles.css and use tokens instead of literals.

#9Badges and status

Page
Catalogue cards, Admin tables, Data sources, Data quality
What's wrong
Four parallel severity systems (.sens, .qband, .ml-sev, .kg-level) plus .dq-badge in amber and red, which are outside the palette. Status is shown three ways: a dot with text in Admin ("Active"), an outlined pill (Warning) and a tint pill (Healthy). Badge radii range from 3px to 99px.
Benchmark
Primer Label is a 20–24px pill at 12px/500. Atlassian keeps a status lozenge separate from a metadata tag.
Fix
Two components. .badge for status: a 20px pill with a dot (ok = ice, warn = royal outline, bad = navy). .tag for metadata: 20px, radius 6. Map amber and red to the navy levels.

#10Chips and filters

Page
Catalogue, Galaxy, Marketplace, Lineage
What's wrong
Suggestion chips are 31px pills. Source chips are 36px with an 8px radius. KG filter chips are 24px with a 6px radius. Marketplace .pill2 is 32px with an 8px radius. .cm-chip is 24px mono.
Benchmark
Linear and Atlan use one compact filter chip with a clear selected state.
Fix
One .chip: 28px, 6px radius, 12.5px text. The selected state is --ice with a --royal border.

#11Whole page

Page
Data sources (all 5 tabs)
What's wrong
The page is an iframe (public/sources/index.html) with its own tokens:
  • --ink #0D264F (the app's --navy is #0E2A57)
  • --blue #447DE6 (the app's --royal is #4D8CFF)
  • --line #E1E8F1
It also has 14.5px body text, a .btn.xs at 29px with a 7px radius, 14.5px tabs, and a header that sits 8px right of and lower than every other page (compare the two images).
Benchmark
Every benchmark product uses one design system across all pages.
Fix
Short term: map the iframe tokens and sizes to the app's (.btn, .btn.xs → sm 28, .sel → md 32, tabs = .tabs). Longer term: port the page to React.

#12Page headers

Page
Catalogue, Galaxy, Explorer, Admin, Code analyzer
What's wrong
Headers are built differently:
  • Catalogue has an eyebrow but no H1.
  • Galaxy, Explorer and the Admin pages have no eyebrow.
Header actions line up differently on each page:
  • Estate: bottom
  • Users: floating mid-way
  • Sources: centred
  • Code analyzer: "Demo data" chip on its own at the bottom right
The Users search (38px) sits next to 36px buttons.
Benchmark
Stripe and Vercel use one page-header pattern: title and description on the left, actions on the right in a fixed position.
Fix
One PageHead (it already exists in ui.jsx) on every page, with the same eyebrow/H1/sub pattern. Actions always align to the bottom of the header block. The toolbar below uses md 32.

#13Card links "API access", "Event logs"

Page
Admin › Overview
What's wrong
These links are plain navy text with no colour, arrow or underline, so they look like labels.
Benchmark
Primer and Atlassian link buttons use the accent colour and underline on hover.
Fix
.btn.link in --royal with an arrow icon. Merge .kg-clear, .rail-clear, .fmore, .rel-link and .bracket into it.

#14Breadcrumb

Page
Admin (all pages)
What's wrong
The breadcrumb reads "Admin / Admin / Users": the group name and page name are both "Admin".
Benchmark
Vercel and Supabase breadcrumbs never repeat a level.
Fix
Skip the page crumb when it equals the group label.

#15Left rail (collapsed)

Page
Admin, Knowledge graph
What's wrong
It opens collapsed by default: 14 unlabelled icons, with only a title tooltip and no aria-label. Some icons, such as Users and Groups, are near-identical.
Benchmark
Geist says icon-only buttons need an aria-label and a tooltip. Supabase and Vercel side navs show labels by default.
Fix
Open by default at 1280px and wider. Add aria-label and a styled tooltip when collapsed.

#16Floating Ask GenMeta button

Page
All pages
What's wrong
The 48px button covers content in the bottom-right corner: the DQ Score column, the SSO Download button, table cells and card text.
Benchmark
Launchers such as Intercom reserve a safe area; Linear doesn't float one over data.
Fix
Add about 88px of bottom padding to .content, or move Ask into the top bar (it's already reachable from the search).

#17Row actions

Page
Stewardship
What's wrong
Five navy primary Approve buttons in one list compete for attention.
Benchmark
Primer, Atlassian and Stripe: at most one primary per region.
Fix
Rows: Approve is sm secondary, Reject is sm ghost. One primary "Approve selected" in the card header.

#18Duplicate action and spacing

Page
Asset › Data quality (Profiling, Scorecards)
What's wrong
"Run profiling" (primary, 30px) at the top right and "Profile and check now" (ghost) below do the same job. In Scorecards, the "Asset quality" button touches the card above with no gap.

#19Filter toolbar and KPI strip

Page
Data sources at 1280px
What's wrong
At 1280px, "Group by" and the view switch wrap onto a second row, and the 7th KPI tile sits alone on its own row.

Linear and Atlan collapse the extra filters into a "Filters" button.

#20Pagination

Page
Catalogue, Marketplace, Users, Logs
What's wrong

Benchmark
Primer Pagination uses 32px squares; Stripe tables show "1–25 of N" with previous and next.

What's wrong

GenMeta button standard

Variants

VariantClassLookUse for
Primary.btn.primary--navy bg, white text; hover --deepThe single main action of a page or panel
Secondary.btn.secondary (keep .btn.ghost as an alias for now)White, 1px --line2, --shadow-1; hover --mist bg and --muted borderEveryday actions (Export, Copy, Approve in rows)
Ghost.btn.ghost (new meaning)Transparent, navy text; hover --iceLow-emphasis actions (Reject, Cancel) and toolbar icons
Link.btn.link--royal 500; underline on hover"View all", "API access →"
Icon.btn.icon + variantSquare, width = height, --r-ctl; aria-label requiredStar, back, refresh, delete, info

Destructive actions stay secondary or ghost and get a confirmation step. No red: the palette stays blue and navy.

Sizes (inputs, selects, segmented and chips use the same scale)

SizeHeightPaddingTextIcon / gapWhere
sm28 (--h-sm)0 10px12.5px / 50014 / 6pxTable rows, cards, chips, sub-tabs
md32 (--h-md)0 12px13px / 50016 / 8pxToolbars, filter bars, segmented, pagination
lg (default)36 (--h-lg)0 14px13.5px / 50016 / 8pxPage header actions, forms, admin settings

Radius is --r-ctl (8px) for buttons, inputs, selects and the segmented track; 6px for chips, tags, sub-tabs and the inner segment; 99px only for status badges and counts; --r-card (12px) for cards. Rule: controls in the same row are always the same size.

States

StateRule
HoverMust be visible: primary → --deep, secondary → --mist with a --muted border, ghost/icon → --ice. Tabs, segments, chips and selects get hover too.
Focus:focus-visible { box-shadow: var(--ring) }, where --ring is a 2px white gap plus a 2px --royal ring, on every control. Inputs use the same ring instead of their own rgba values.
Active / selectedTabs: 2px --royal underline. Sub-tabs, segments and chips: --ice bg with --navy text (chips also get a --royal border).
Disabled--ice bg, --line border, --faint text, no hover, cursor:not-allowed. No opacity tricks.
LoadingA spinner replaces the icon, the width is kept, and aria-busy is set.

Keep, merge, retire

  • Keep these tokens: --navy --deep --royal --ice --mist --line --line2 --muted --faint --r-ctl --r-card --shadow-1, Hanken Grotesk, and JetBrains Mono (identifiers and the eyebrow only).
  • Add sizing tokens only (no colours): --h-sm/--h-md/--h-lg and --ring.
  • Keep these classes: .btn (+ primary/secondary/ghost/link/icon/sm/md), .tabs, .seg2 (the segmented standard), .chip, .input, .select, .switch. Add .subtabs, .badge and .tag.
  • Merge and retire:
    • .toggle and .seg → .seg2
    • .asset-tabs and .ls-tabs → .tabs; the lineage, DQ, KG and CA sub-tabs → .subtabs
    • .kg-clear, .rail-clear, .fmore, .rel-link and .bracket → .btn.link
    • .examples button, .achip, .cm-chip, .kg-fchip, .chip-btn and .pill2 → .chip
    • .sens, .qband, .ml-sev, .kg-level, .dq-badge, .status and .pill → .badge/.tag
    • .dq-field input and .kg-field input → .input
    • the control rules in styles.css that pro.css already overrides → delete

Claude Code prompt

Branch: git checkout main && git pull && git checkout -b karan-ui-hygiene. Don't commit.

Apply one button/control standard across the app. Reuse existing tokens only
(--navy --deep --royal --ice --mist --line --line2 --muted --faint --r-ctl). No new colours or fonts.

1. src/pro.css: add --h-sm:28px --h-md:32px --h-lg:36px and
   --ring: 0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 0 4px var(--royal).
   .btn = lg 36 (default), .btn.md 32, .btn.sm 28. Variants: primary, secondary
   (current ghost look, keep .ghost as alias), ghost (transparent, hover --ice), link, icon (square).
   Visible hover on all. :focus-visible uses --ring on every control.
   :disabled = --ice bg / --faint text, no hover.
   .input/.select/.seg2/.chip use the same heights; .select gets appearance:none + one chevron.
2. Merge duplicates:
   .toggle/.seg -> .seg2 (selected = --ice bg, navy text)
   .asset-tabs/.ls-tabs -> .tabs (44px, 14px)
   lineage/DQ/KG/code-analyzer sub-tabs -> new .subtabs (28px pills)
   .kg-clear/.rail-clear/.fmore/.rel-link/.bracket -> .btn.link
   chip variants -> .chip (28px, r6)
   severity/status badges -> .badge (20px pill) / .tag (20px, r6)
   Delete control rules in styles.css that pro.css overrides.
3. Add Button, IconButton, Segmented, Tabs and Badge to src/components/ui.jsx
   and use them where you touch markup.
4. Page fixes:
   - asset header: all 36
   - Graph explorer form: flex-end, equal heights
   - Galaxy: toggle on the title row
   - Users filter: Segmented, sentence case
   - Stewardship rows: sm secondary Approve + ghost Reject
   - Admin overview links: .btn.link
   - no "Admin / Admin" breadcrumb
   - SSO download icon
   - bottom padding so the Ask FAB doesn't cover content
5. public/sources/index.html: map its --ink/--blue/--line to the app values, and match
   .btn/.btn.xs/.sel/tabs to the same sizes.

Check: npm run build passes and there are no console errors.

Sources used for benchmarks

  • Primer: primer.style Button, SegmentedControl, UnderlineNav and Pagination, and the primer/primitives size tokens.
  • Atlassian: atlassian.design Button, Tabs, Lozenge and Tag.
  • Vercel Geist: vercel.com/geist/button.
  • Supabase: supabase.com/design-system, and packages/ui Button.tsx.
  • Stripe: docs.stripe.com/stripe-apps/components (button, badge).
  • Linear: the linear.app site CSS; the product app has no public spec.
  • Atlan: docs.atlan.com asset profiles; there are no public pixel specs.
